# Sphere [Area of Effect]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Areas of Effect](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#SphereAreaofEffect)*

A Sphere is an [area of effect](Area-of-Effect.md) that extends in straight lines from a point of origin outward in all directions. The effect that creates a Sphere specifies the distance it extends as the radius of the Sphere.

A Sphere's point of origin is included in the Sphere's area of effect.
